# Camouflare 1.3.3

> Draft for maintainer review. Remove this note before publishing the GitHub Release.

Camouflare 1.3.3 is a patch release that classifies malformed JSON request bodies as
invalid client input and strengthens release validation for changelog comparison links.

## What changed

- Malformed or non-UTF-8 JSON request bodies now return the stable `INVALID_REQUEST`
  error code instead of `INTERNAL_ERROR`.
- Expected JSON parsing failures no longer emit unexpected-error tracebacks.
- Release verification rejects stale or missing `Unreleased` and current-version
  changelog comparison links.
- The changelog now separates the published 1.3.2 range from changes made after that
  release.

## Upgrading

No configuration changes are required. Successful commands are unchanged. For
FlareSolverr compatibility, malformed JSON still returns HTTP 500, but clients now receive
`errorCode: "INVALID_REQUEST"`, `retryable: false`, and a stable message instead of a
Python parser error classified as an internal failure.

## Container image

The immutable release image is available for Linux `amd64` and `arm64`:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/mehmetcansahin/camouflare:1.3.3
```

See the
[changelog](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.3/CHANGELOG.md#133---2026-08-25)
for the complete entry and the
[deployment guide](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v1.3.3/docs/deployment.md)
for production constraints and rollback guidance.
